_about: Scout drone (2026-11-14 upgrade paths): flight rules shared by every level. What changes with the level (speed, flight time, survey radius, autopilot, waypoints) is in data/area_levels.json (track scout_drone) and the radio range in the command track (command.drone_range_m). Every number here and there is DESIGNER BALANCE chosen for pacing and fun for ages 9-12, never a NASA figure. The drone's look takes cues from NASA's Ingenuity Mars helicopter (illustrative only, no number is taken from it). Positions are Godot metres.

_notes.charge_per_s: designer balance: about 90 real seconds from empty to full on the pad charger (the charger is not counted in the colony power budget).
_notes.launch_min_battery: designer balance: the drone will not take off with less than 20 % battery.
_notes.battery_reserve: designer balance: the drone turns home by itself when its battery holds only the trip home plus 5 %.
_notes.empty_return_speed_factor: designer balance: with an empty battery the drone limps home at half speed on its emergency cell.
_notes.range_warn_fraction: designer balance: a warning at 90 % of the command room's radio range; the drone stops at the edge.
_notes.cruise_altitude_m: designer balance: the autopilot flies 12 m above the ground.
_notes.survey_hover_s: designer balance: the autopilot hovers 5 s over each waypoint to film it with the survey camera.
